notes: The article text says three Sub-Categories are grouped into Misc; the author workbook groups five (Art, Envelopes, Fasteners, Labels, Supplies), which is what the published visualisation shows and what is rebuilt here.

pPrior counts the current month, so the WINDOW_AVG start offset is (-1*[pPrior])+1; with the default 3 the Accessories June 2018 value is the mean of April..September 2018, matching the article's worked example.
The shaded band is the nested WINDOW_MAX/WINDOW_MIN of Moving Avg addressed by Sub-Category (group) with month as nested addressing.
Final Cloud and independent oracle evidence supersedes earlier static-only assumptions; see evidence/cloud-data-verification.json and evidence/visual-review.md.
